question: For the top 20 Citi Bike routes in 2016, which route is faster than yellow taxis and among those, which one has the longest average bike duration? Please provide the start station name of this route. The coordinates are rounded to three decimals.
sql:
WITH top_routes AS (
    SELECT start_station_name, end_station_name,
           ROUND(AVG(start_station_latitude), 3) as start_lat, 
           ROUND(AVG(start_station_longitude), 3) as start_lon,
           ROUND(AVG(end_station_latitude), 3) as end_lat,
           ROUND(AVG(end_station_longitude), 3) as end_lon,
           COUNT(*) as trip_count, 
           AVG(tripduration) as avg_bike_duration,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE DATE(starttime) >= '2016-01-01' AND DATE(starttime) < '2017-01-01'
    GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2800
),
taxi_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3) as plat, 
        ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3) as plon,
        ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3) as dlat,
        ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3) as dlon,
        AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as avg_taxi_duration,
        COUNT(*) as taxi_count
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
    WHERE pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL AND pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
      AND dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL AND dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL
      AND pickup_latitude != 0 AND pickup_longitude != 0
      AND dropoff_latitude != 0 AND dropoff_longitude != 0
      AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) > 0
      AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) < 7200
    GROUP BY plat, plon, dlat, dlon
)
SELECT tr.start_station_name, tr.end_station_name, ROUND(tr.avg_bike_duration, 2) as avg_bike_duration
FROM top_routes tr
LEFT JOIN taxi_stats ts 
    ON tr.start_lat = ts.plat AND tr.start_lon = ts.plon 
    AND tr.end_lat = ts.dlat AND tr.end_lon = ts.dlon
WHERE tr.rn <= 20
  AND ts.avg_taxi_duration IS NOT NULL
  AND tr.avg_bike_duration < ts.avg_taxi_duration
ORDER BY tr.avg_bike_duration DESC
LIMIT 1
